sync-vended-versions.description: Sync vended dependency versions and the tracked plugin version to those vended by this release

v1.0.0-rc.50-modernize-function-props-ca.description: Replace the legacy angle-bracket FunctionProps type assertion with the modern as syntax in generated API constructs

v1.0.0-rc.50-restrict-cors-to-custom-dom.description: Include CloudFront custom domain aliases in restrictCorsTo and UserIdentity callback URLs

v1.0.0-rc.50-terraform-bootstrap-adopt-e.description: Adopt an existing Terraform state bucket in the vended bootstrap script when its state object is missing

v1.0.0-rc.52-user-identity-waf-allow-loc.description: Count the EC2MetaDataSSRF_QUERYARGUMENTS WAF rule on the UserIdentity Web ACL so sign-in from a local dev server is not blocked

v1.0.0-rc.54-order-access-log-delivery-a.description: Order the S3 server access log delivery source after the bucket policy to avoid a 409 from concurrent bucket configuration writes

v1.0.0-rc.55-backfill-generator-metadata.description: Backfill the project metadata the version sync reads, recovered from the files the generators left behind

v1.0.0-rc.56-dynamodb-local-remove-optim.description: Drop -optimizeDbBeforeStartup from the vended DynamoDB Local container script, which can corrupt shared-local-instance.db

v1.0.0-rc.57-ts-agent-session-management.description: Add session management support to ts#agent

latest-smithy-ssdk-bundle-pins.description: Bump the rolldown and dts plugin pins in the Smithy build.Dockerfile so the bundled SSDK type declaration resolves

latest-gateway-agent-targets.description: Add agent runtime target support to the vended AgentCoreGateway construct and an agentName member to vended agent constructs
